101-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6797-7084-8338.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-7452.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-7452.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

4185-4490--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4185-4490--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Celestial Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4185-4490--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

803-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
803-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2034-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-3899-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-5332.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with two +1/+1 counters on it

1597-4644-7791.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Gyre Sage.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Gyre Sage.
Repeat.

215-3043-3480.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1966-3719-6981.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more artifacts.
1966-3719-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Ruthless Technomancer.
Activate Nim Shambler by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer dies, its ability given to it by Perigee Beckoner triggers, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Nim Shambler and creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to Nim Shambler's power.
Resolve the Nim Shambler ability from step 3.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Nim Shambler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Nim Shambler by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1966-3719-6981.notes: You can reduce the number of artifacts you control to start by adding additional mana. You must create at least six Treasures, and therefore must control at least seven artifacts to start. The remaining three can be reduced by adding up to {4}{B}{B} in mana to pay for Ruthless Technomancer's abilities. The needed mana is as follows: {4}{B}{B} extra if you control seven artifacts, {4} if you control eight artifacts and {2} if you control nine artifacts. You must ensure to have ten artifacts remaining after sacrificing six to the abilities, and sacrificing additional Treasures for mana. You may also skip step 7 in these circumstances and/or sacrifice less Treasures. You can also boost Nim Shambler's power using an anthem effect (such as Always Watching).

880-4826-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4826-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-4321-5147-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5147-6277.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

315-1661-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3845-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2921-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2921-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2921-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1479-5700-5701-6662.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-6662.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2523-4050-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2523-4050-5560.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien, adding one mana of any color.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2034-2091-2239-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least seven tapped lands.
2034-2091-2239-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3967-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2558-2829-5687-5688.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-6096.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

4499-4605-5419-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kalain.
When Kalain enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Kalain triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Kalain that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Kalain token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

198-915-5295.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-915-5295.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Thousand-Year Elixir and Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

1409-1494-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Sage of Hours.
1409-1494-2646.description:
Activate Sage of Hours by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
When Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

942-2034-4336-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {C}{C}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {C}{C}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1563-1867-2206-2557-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

427-4222-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-4222-4758.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

439-2713-3458-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding {R}.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Impromptu Raid by paying {R/G}, revealing Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1656-2335-4017-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Necrotic Ooze.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-2335-4017-5162.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Kwain's ability by tapping it, allowing each player to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Necrotic Ooze triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2011-2034-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Warriors that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2011-2034-3263.description:
Declare Najeela and at least two other Warriors as attackers.
Najeela triggers at least three times, creating at least three 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Warriors, adding {6}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1987-2427-2556.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2427-2556.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

2236-2451-3069-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Witch Engine, causing target player to mill cards equal to Witch Engine's power.
Activate Witch Engine's unearth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste and exiling it at end of turn or when it leaves the battlefield.
Activate Witch Engine by tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Witch Engine.
Both Witch Engine's undying ability and Void Maw attempt to exile Witch Engine when it would be put into your graveyard.
Choose to apply the Void Maw replacement effect, exiling Witch Engine.
Resolve the Witch Engine ability from step 3, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Witch Engine's power.
Activate Void Maw by putting Witch Engine from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
